summary: Iteration 10 - Zoho CRM Integration, Checkout Flow, Price Calculator Testing Complete. All 10 features tested successfully. 13/14 backend tests passed (1 minor unrelated endpoint issue). All frontend UI tests passed.

minor.issue: Returns 404 - endpoint not found. This is a pre-existing issue, not related to new features being tested.

critical_code_review_comments: Zoho CRM leads are saved to MongoDB crm_leads collection correctly - zoho_status shows 'failed' because ZOHO_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/REFRESH_TOKEN are not configured (EXPECTED)
Stripe checkout session creation works correctly with proper validation
PayPal button redirects to paypal.me/Abrisia as expected
Price calculator formula is correct: width * depth * floors * rate
seed_data_creation: Test leads created in crm_leads collection with TEST_ prefix emails
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 tested new Zoho CRM integration, checkout flow, and price calculator. Key findings: 1) Hero text updated to 'Des plans sur mesure, conçus pour votre réalité' - PASS, 2) Collection page product modal shows 'Personnaliser' button alongside 'Ajouter au panier' - PASS, 3) Customize modal has all required fields (first_name, last_name, email, phone, message) - PASS, 4) Customize form submission posts to /api/zoho/lead/customize and shows success toast - PASS, 5) Checkout modal shows Stripe and PayPal payment buttons - PASS, 6) Price calculator in Devis page works correctly (30*40*1*3.50=4200$) - PASS, 7) All Zoho lead endpoints work (/api/zoho/lead/customize, /api/zoho/lead/devis, /api/zoho/lead/purchase, /api/zoho/leads) - PASS. Note: Zoho sync shows synced=False because Zoho credentials not configured - this is EXPECTED behavior.
